question: 2026-10-16 的日活用户数 DAU 是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.user_id) AS dau FROM fact_user_event f JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_id = f.date_id WHERE d.full_date = '2026-10-16'

question: 2026-10-15 这天有多少活跃用户？
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.user_id) AS dau FROM fact_user_event f JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_id = f.date_id WHERE d.full_date = '2026-10-15'

question: 2026-10-16 的浏览量 PV 是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS pv FROM fact_user_event f JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_id = f.date_id WHERE d.full_date = '2026-10-16' AND f.event_type = 'view'

question: 2026-10-16 新增注册用户有多少人？
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS new_users FROM dim_user WHERE register_date = '2026-10-16'

question: 2026-10-16 下单的用户有多少人？
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.user_id) AS order_users FROM fact_user_event f JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_id = f.date_id WHERE d.full_date = '2026-10-16' AND f.event_type = 'order'

question: 2026-10-16 一共产生了多少笔订单？
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM fact_user_event f JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_id = f.date_id WHERE d.full_date = '2026-10-16' AND f.event_type = 'order'

question: 2026-10-16 支付成功的用户有多少人？
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.user_id) AS pay_users FROM fact_user_event f JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_id = f.date_id WHERE d.full_date = '2026-10-16' AND f.event_type = 'pay'

question: 2026-10-16 的 GMV（支付总金额）是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(f.amount) AS gmv FROM fact_user_event f JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_id = f.date_id WHERE d.full_date = '2026-10-16' AND f.event_type = 'pay'

question: 2026-10-16 的客单价是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(f.amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT f.user_id) AS aov FROM fact_user_event f JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_id = f.date_id WHERE d.full_date = '2026-10-16' AND f.event_type = 'pay'

question: 2026-10-16 加购的用户有多少人？
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.user_id) AS cart_users FROM fact_user_event f JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_id = f.date_id WHERE d.full_date = '2026-10-16' AND f.event_type = 'cart'

question: 2026-10-16 浏览商品的用户有多少人？
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.user_id) AS view_users FROM fact_user_event f JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_id = f.date_id WHERE d.full_date = '2026-10-16' AND f.event_type = 'view'

question: 2026-10-16 浏览到支付的整体转化率是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.event_type = 'pay' THEN f.user_id END) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN f.event_type = 'view' THEN f.user_id END) AS view_to_pay_rate FROM fact_user_event f JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_id = f.date_id WHERE d.full_date = '2026-10-16'

question: 2026-10-16 浏览、加购、下单、支付每个环节分别有多少去重用户？
reference_sql: SELECT f.event_type, COUNT(DISTINCT f.user_id) AS users FROM fact_user_event f JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_id = f.date_id WHERE d.full_date = '2026-10-16' AND f.event_type IN ('view','cart','order','pay') GROUP BY f.event_type

question: 2026-10-16 各渠道的支付 GMV 分别是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT c.channel_name, SUM(f.amount) AS gmv FROM fact_user_event f JOIN dim_channel c ON c.channel_id = f.channel_id JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_id = f.date_id WHERE d.full_date = '2026-10-16' AND f.event_type = 'pay' GROUP BY c.channel_name

question: 2026-10-16 各渠道分别有多少活跃用户？
reference_sql: SELECT c.channel_name, COUNT(DISTINCT f.user_id) AS active_users FROM fact_user_event f JOIN dim_channel c ON c.channel_id = f.channel_id JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_id = f.date_id WHERE d.full_date = '2026-10-16' GROUP BY c.channel_name

question: 2026 年 10 月每天的日活分别是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT d.full_date, COUNT(DISTINCT f.user_id) AS dau FROM fact_user_event f JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_id = f.date_id WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-16' GROUP BY d.full_date

question: 2026 年 10 月 1 日到 16 日的总 GMV 是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(f.amount) AS gmv FROM fact_user_event f JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_id = f.date_id WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-16' AND f.event_type = 'pay'

question: 2026 年 10 月 1 日到 16 日一共有多少笔订单？
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM fact_user_event f JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_id = f.date_id WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-16' AND f.event_type = 'order'

question: 2026 年 10 月 1 日到 16 日各品类的 GMV 分别是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(f.amount) AS gmv FROM fact_user_event f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = f.product_id JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_id = f.date_id WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-16' AND f.event_type = 'pay' GROUP BY p.category

question: 10 月上半月 GMV 最高的三个品类是什么？
reference_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(f.amount) AS gmv FROM fact_user_event f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = f.product_id JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_id = f.date_id WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-16' AND f.event_type = 'pay' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY gmv DESC LIMIT 3

question: 手机数码品类一共有多少个商品？
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dim_product WHERE category = '手机数码'

question: 单价超过 3000 元的商品有多少个？
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dim_product WHERE price > 3000

question: 2026-10-16 各品类分别被浏览了多少次？
reference_sql: SELECT p.category, COUNT(*) AS view_count FROM fact_user_event f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = f.product_id JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_id = f.date_id WHERE d.full_date = '2026-10-16' AND f.event_type = 'view' GROUP BY p.category

question: 名称里包含“手机”两个字的商品，总共被浏览了多少次？
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS view_count FROM fact_user_event f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_id = f.product_id JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_id = f.date_id WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN '2026-07-19' AND '2026-10-16' AND f.event_type = 'view' AND p.product_name LIKE '%手机%'

question: 各城市分别有多少用户？
reference_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS user_count FROM dim_user GROUP BY city

question: 男性用户一共有多少人？
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS male_users FROM dim_user WHERE gender = '男'

question: 25 岁以下的用户有多少人？
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM dim_user WHERE age < 25

question: 女性用户的平均年龄是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT AVG(age) AS avg_age FROM dim_user WHERE gender = '女'

question: 2026 年 10 月 1 日到 16 日支付次数大于等于两次的复购用户有多少人？
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS repeat_pay_users FROM (SELECT f.user_id FROM fact_user_event f JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_id = f.date_id WHERE d.full_date BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-16' AND f.event_type = 'pay' GROUP BY f.user_id HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) t

question: 2026-10-16 北京用户的支付总金额是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(f.amount) AS gmv FROM fact_user_event f JOIN dim_user u ON u.user_id = f.user_id JOIN dim_date d ON d.date_id = f.date_id WHERE d.full_date = '2026-10-16' AND f.event_type = 'pay' AND u.city = '北京'
